description_en: Retrieves the short link for a card message
kebab_example: aliyun dysmsapi get-card-sms-link --card-template-code 'CARD_SMS_****' --sign-name-json '[\"阿里云\", \"阿里云2\"]' --api-version 2017-05-25 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetCardSmsLink

parameters.help_en: The code of the card message template. Select an approved card message template code on the Card Messages > Template Management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/card) page in the console
parameters.help_zh: 卡片短信模板Code。请在控制台卡片短信>模板管理 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/card)页面选择已通过审核的卡片短信模板Code
parameters.name: card_template_code

parameters.help_en: The extended field for the external ID
parameters.name: out_id

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone number, user ID, or internal system identifier.

A maximum of 10,000 mobile phone numbers are supported.
You can also use a custom identifier, which cannot exceed 60 characters in length.
For OPPO templates, you can apply for a maximum of 10 at a time
parameters.help_zh:
手机号码、用户ID或系统内部标识。

最多支持1万个手机号码。
用户也可自定义标识，长度不超过60个字符。
OPPO厂商的模板一次最多申请10个
parameters.name: phone_number_json

parameters.help_en:
The name of the text message signature.
You can view the signature name in the Signature Name column on the Domestic Messages > Signature Management (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign) tab in the console. You can also call the QuerySmsSignList (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/sms/developer-reference/api-dysmsapi-2017-05-25-querysmssignlist) operation to query the text message signature name.

The signature must be added and approved. The number of signatures must be the same as the number of mobile phone numbers, and the signatures must correspond to the mobile phone numbers one by one
parameters.help_zh:
短信签名名称。
请在控制台国内消息>签名管理 (https://dysms.console.aliyun.com/domestic/text/sign)页签下签名名称一列查看。也可通过QuerySmsSignList (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/sms/developer-reference/api-dysmsapi-2017-05-25-querysmssignlist?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-search-44282.d_0)接口查看的短信签名名称。

必须是已添加、并通过审核的短信签名；且短信签名的个数必须与手机号码的个数相同、内容一一对应
parameters.name: sign_name_json

parameters.help_en: The dynamic parameters of the card message
parameters.name: card_template_param_json

parameters.help_en:
The encoding type of the short link for the card message. Valid values:
1: mass messaging
2: personalized messaging
parameters.help_zh:
卡片短信短链编码类型。取值：
1：群发。
2：个性化
parameters.name: card_code_type

parameters.help_en:
The type of the short link for the card message. Valid values:
1: standard generated short code
2: custom generated short code

If CardLinkType is not specified, the default value is the standard generated short code. To generate a custom short code, contact Alibaba Cloud operations personnel for registration
parameters.help_zh:
卡片短信短链类型。取值：
1：标准生成短码。
2：自定义生成短码。

CardLinkType不填时，默认为标准生成短码。如需生成自定义短码，请联系阿里运营人员进行报备
parameters.name: card_link_type

parameters.help_en:
The short link domain name assigned to the sending account, which must be registered in advance.

When CardLinkType is set to 2, the Domain parameter is required.
If the Domain parameter is not specified, the system default domain name is used. The length cannot exceed 100 characters
parameters.help_zh:
发送账号分配的短链域名，需要提前报备。

当CardLinkType为2时，Domain参数必填。
当Domain参数不填时，则使用系统默认域名。长度不超过100个字符
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The custom short code. The length must be 4 to 8 characters and can contain only digits and letters.

This parameter is required when the generation type is custom generated short code
parameters.help_zh:
客户自定义短码。长度为4~8位的数字或字母。

当生成类型为自定义生成短码时必填
parameters.name: custom_short_code_json

Code.description_en:
The request status code. Valid values:
OK: The request is successful.
For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。取值：
OK：代表请求成功。
其他错误码，请参见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/101346.html）

CardPhoneNumbers.description_en: The mobile phone numbers that support card messages
CardPhoneNumbers.description_zh: 支持卡片短信的手机号码

CardSignNames.description_en: The text message signatures used to apply for the short links of the card messages. When sending messages, the signature, recipient mobile phone number, and short link must correspond to each other one by one
CardSignNames.description_zh: 用于申请卡片短信短链的短信签名，在发送时签名、接收号码、卡片短信短链要一一对应

CardSmsLinks.description_en: The short links for the card messages

CardTmpState.description_en:
The review status of the card message template. Valid values:
0: Under review.
1: Approved.
2: Rejected.

Messages that are not approved fall back to standard text messages
CardTmpState.description_zh:
卡片短信模板审核状态。取值：
0：审核中。
1：审核通过。
2：审核不通过。

未审核通过的短信走回落流程

NotMediaMobiles.description_en: The mobile phone numbers that do not support card messages
NotMediaMobiles.description_zh: 不支持卡片短信的手机号

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call is successful. Valid values:

true: The call is successful.
false: The call fails
Success.description_zh:
接口调用是否成功。取值：

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
